questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the Domain Name System (DNS)?

answers.a: To translate hostnames into IP addresses
answers.b: To establish encrypted communication between two hosts

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of DNS server?
Which DNS query type allows the server to take full responsibility for finding the answer?
Which DNS record type is used to map a hostname to an IP address?
What is the function of a CNAME record in DNS?

answers.a: It maps a domain name to another domain name
answers.b: It specifies a mail exchange server
answers.c: It translates IP addresses to hostnames
